target.title: feat: add private AWS workspace service
target.body:
## Summary

- add a private, SSM-only AWS workspace path that uses the AWS SDK default credential chain and fails closed on account, Region, ECS task-role identity, and permissions
- enforce allowlisted small instance classes, encrypted configurable gp3 storage, private-subnet placement, no public address or SSH, IMDSv2, bounded networking, exact tags, lifecycle evidence, and idempotent cleanup
- add a dedicated internal ALB/ECS/PostgreSQL coordinator stack with separate execution, task, and workspace roles
- document the client URL/token contract, readiness checks, create/status/delete lifecycle, live canary, retirement procedure, and source-blind behavior contract

## Why

The portable AWS path assumes static credentials and large default workspace resources. A dedicated-account deployment needs renewable task-role credentials, strict placement checks, smaller cost-bounded workspaces, and an isolated controller that does not depend on a reusable shared control plane.

## Security and operating boundary

- the dedicated deployment rejects static AWS access keys and requires the expected account, Region, ECS metadata, and task-role identity before provisioning
- workspaces use a private subnet, no public IPv4/IPv6 address, no key pair or inbound security-group rules, IMDSv2, SSM bootstrap, encrypted gp3 volumes, and exact ownership tags
- the stack fixes this deployment to on-demand capacity and exposes instance type and volume limits only through an explicit allowlist
- the Node image pins the AWS RDS CA bundle by checksum and scopes it to PostgreSQL through `sslrootcert`; it does not change process-wide TLS trust
- this change contains no credentials, customer-specific source configuration, release changes, or version/tag changes

## Verification

Validated at exact head `61f65f220414a008b7579417df40afcaed06bc5f` (tree `1db538767da9a1d35d0ad61d3843cdfe5fbf8546`):

- `npm run format:check --prefix worker`
- `npm run check --prefix worker`
- `npm run check:node --prefix worker`
- focused Worker suites: 588 passed across AWS private/deployment, bootstrap, fleet, HTTP, PostgreSQL storage, and coordinator runtime tests
- `node --test scripts/aws-ecs-fargate-coordinator.test.js` (7 passed)
- canonical structured branch autoreview found one launch-vs-cleanup availability issue; the accepted fix passed focused rereview clean at confidence 0.91

Earlier full-branch proof also passed Go build/vet/race, provider lifecycles, Worker lint/build/full test, docs, CloudFormation lint, and exact-head hosted CI; the final rebased head is additionally gated by the current hosted runs.

## Live AWS acceptance

Authenticated acceptance passed in account `433939225574`, Region `us-west-2`, at exact head `61f65f220414a008b7579417df40afcaed06bc5f`:

- dedicated foundation and coordinator stacks are `UPDATE_COMPLETE`; the coordinator runs privately on ECS Fargate with separate execution, task, and workspace roles
- exact-head image tag `61f65f220414` is pinned and running as digest `sha256:67344d0c7f512079b1f5cf98f2f704684a70ca13572bb9c8442865ba66ffe2a6`; ECS container and internal ALB target are healthy
- readiness returned `{"ok":true}` through a certificate-verified SSM tunnel; no public control-plane route was used
- separate certificate-verified liveness and readiness probes both passed; launch readiness gates new workspace POSTs while status/delete remain on the liveness path
- canary workspace `exact-head-61f65f22-1783769749` / lease `cbx_91076a380989` reached `ready` on instance `i-0706eefc4fd89a40d`
- posture: `t3a.small`, private IP only, no key pair, private subnet `subnet-0a9ed271ea27811da`, workspace security group `sg-0232b5f3976fa40ca`, IMDSv2 required with hop limit 1 and metadata tags/IPv6 disabled
- storage: encrypted 20 GiB gp3 volume `vol-01b8e8b87bcc9165f`, delete-on-termination enabled
- SSM bootstrap command `686ee2d1-e895-4d4c-b4c6-680bb1cedf8a` completed `Success` with response code 0 and retained CloudWatch output
- identical create returned the same provider resource; delete reached `stopped`; repeated delete remained `stopped`
- EC2 instance terminated and the encrypted workspace volume was absent after cleanup
- the temporary private SSM proof client and its volume were also terminated/deleted; no proof resources remain

No credential or bearer value is included in this PR or its proof.
